findings.evidence: PowerBounds.lean:11-33 module docstring lists no derivative bound; `norm_iteratedDeriv_resolventFun_le` is public at PowerBounds.lean:290 and :318. Deriv.lean:32-41 `## Main results` lists only hasDerivAt/iteratedDeriv/contDiffOn; the diff removes the two `norm_iteratedDeriv_resolventFun_le` declarations from Deriv.lean.
findings.fix: Add one sentence to the PowerBounds module docstring, e.g. "The sharp derivative bound `‖dⁿR(lambda)/dlambdaⁿ‖ ≤ n! M / (lambda - omega)^(n+1)` follows from the power bound and is recorded here (general and contraction cases)."
findings.issue: The module docstring gives an explicit inventory (power formula, power bound, contraction specialization, pointwise estimates, scaled resolvent) but never mentions `StronglyContinuousSemigroup.norm_iteratedDeriv_resolventFun_le` (line 290) or `ContractionSemigroup.norm_iteratedDeriv_resolventFun_le` (line 318), the two public theorems this PR deletes from Deriv.lean and re-proves here. Deriv.lean's docstring is entirely about differentiation and its `## Main results` list (lines 34-41) no longer names them either, so a reader looking for the derivative bound finds no pointer in the file it used to live in.

summary: The three prior docstring inaccuracies are fixed and all new public declarations are documented accurately. One gap remains: the PowerBounds module docstring enumerates the file's contents but omits the two Hille--Yosida derivative-bound theorems that this PR moves here from Deriv.lean.
